[[Gift of Fortune]] is a [[gift]] used to craft the first set of [[legendary weapon]]s, as well as legendary back pieces. [[Legendary weapon#Generation 2 2|Second generation]] legendaries require a [[Mystic Tribute]] instead.

== Acquisition ==
{{Recipe
| source = Mystic Forge
| quantity = 1
| ingredient1 = 77 Mystic Clover
| ingredient2 = 250 Glob of Ectoplasm
| ingredient3 = 1 Gift of Magic
| ingredient4 = 1 Gift of Might
}}

== Trivia ==
* The Gift of Might and Magic ingredients are likely a reference to the RPG series [[w:Might and Magic|''Might and Magic'']].
* The 77 [[Mystic Clover]]s needed is likely a reference to the fact that 7 is considered a lucky number.
* Between [[Game_updates/2015-12-01#Items|1 December, 2015]] and [[Game_updates/2023-09-12#Items_2|12 September, 2023]], this item could be salvaged to return all base materials.
